commentary.text: The surf is running high, exceeding the local limit for Dike Rock Tidepools, so the reef won’t be fully exposed. With water levels also higher than predicted, visibility of intertidal life will be limited. It’s best to pick another day for a proper tidepool visit, as today’s conditions favor watching the waves rather than exploring the rocks.
